notes: Offered by the Aiiso Yufeng Li Family Department of Chemical and Nano Engineering (subject code CENG). All three source pages corroborate the requirement structure. Basic sciences (54 units): math 24, physics 14, chemistry 16. Chemistry core = three advanced chemistry electives (12 units). CENG core (33 units) includes CENG 4 seminar + 100/110 + 101A-C, 102, 113, 120, 122. General engineering (12 units): CENG 15, 114, 170. Process lab/design (16 units): CENG 124A/B, 176A/B. Technical electives (12 units) = three upper-division/graduate engineering courses. All CENG courses except CENG 4 and CENG 199 must be letter-graded; every major course must be passed with C- or higher. Correction from harvested data: the advanced-chemistry-electives bucket mixes lower- and upper-division courses, so its division is set to 'other' rather than 'upper'.

buckets.label: Mathematics sequence
buckets.note: 24 units. MATH 18 (linear algebra) was formerly MATH 20F. All six required. Confirmed on all sources.

buckets.label: Physics
buckets.note: 14 units. All required. Confirmed on catalog and curriculum pages.

buckets.label: Introductory seminar (CENG 4)
buckets.note: 1-unit introductory seminar/laboratory required of all incoming first-year and transfer students. Part of the 33-unit CENG core on the catalog. Exempt from the letter-grade rule.

buckets.label: Computer programming (MATLAB) - general engineering
buckets.note: Part of the 12-unit general engineering requirement (MATLAB programming). Confirmed lower-division.

buckets.label: Advanced chemistry electives (chemistry core)
buckets.note: Choose three (12 units) from this approved list. Division set to 'other' because the list mixes divisions: CHEM 41A/41B/41C and 43A are lower-division; 114A/114B/120A/120B/130/131/132 are upper-division. CHEM 114A may be substituted by BIBC 100 and CHEM 114B by BIBC 102 (cannot receive credit for both a CHEM course and its BIBC equivalent). Confirmed on all sources.

buckets.label: Chemical process modeling (choose one)
buckets.note: Part of the 33-unit chemical engineering core. CENG 100 or CENG 110. Confirmed.

buckets.label: Chemical engineering core
buckets.note: Part of the 33-unit CENG core. Transport phenomena (101A-C), solution thermodynamics (102), chemical reaction engineering (113), process control (120), unit operations (122). All required. Confirmed.

buckets.label: General engineering (upper-division)
buckets.note: Part of the 12-unit general engineering requirement: CENG 114 (probability/statistics) and CENG 170 (instrumentation). CENG 15 (listed separately) is the lower-division third course. Confirmed.

buckets.label: Process laboratory and design
buckets.note: 16 units. CENG 124A-B (process/plant design) and CENG 176A-B (two-quarter senior process laboratory). All required. Confirmed.

buckets.label: Technical electives
buckets.note: 12 units. Three upper-division or graduate engineering courses from the department's pre-approved technical-elective list. Count confirmed as three (12 units) on the major-requirements and curriculum pages. Students may pursue an area of specialization (e.g., Biotechnology, Microelectronic Devices, Engineering Mechanics, Engineering Science, Environmental Engineering, Materials Science, Nanotechnology, Process Dynamics, Thermal Engineering) by selecting all three from one category.
